evaluation.modes: students in their own training mode; the teacher in both
evaluation.think_state: every generation records the think_state its prompt produced; the preclosed state is scored with no think delimiter allowed in the continuation, and no earlier record or verdict changes
evaluation.every_item: every item of every unit is generated for every checkpoint and for the teacher in both modes

primary_measure: correctness on the 570 formal static items of fluid_reasoning_720 (dev_v1), one nucleus_v1 sample per item and seed, clustered by rule family. AGENTS.md P10.2's four primary axes are each reported apart: task-contained deduction, inductive rule discovery and compositional generalization (static, decided) and interactive adaptation and planning (the 144 interactive episodes, exploratory); abstract/analogical reasoning is a registered sub-category, reported as its own axis

decision_rule.applies: H1's rule shape (h1_statistics.py: pairing, SESOI, floor, resolution), at this study's level and seed

labels.GO_THINKING: the interval lies wholly above +5 pp and both seeds' estimates are above +5 pp
labels.GO_NON_THINKING: the interval lies wholly below -5 pp and both seeds' estimates are below -5 pp
labels.NO_GO: the interval and both seeds' estimates lie inside (-5, +5) pp and neither arm is below 2%: a meaningful difference between the modes is excluded at this scale
labels.NOT_RESOLVED: both arms below 2% (FLOOR); one arm below 2% flagged FLOOR_<arm>

decision_rule.reading: primary and secondary are read separately and never merged

data_budget_rules.scale: per mode 5,923,021 unique supervised tokens = 2,960,507 + 2,962,514 (token_matched_design.json :: scale); each category stops at the first whole-task boundary reaching its target; total excess at most 0.5%, category share within 0.5 points; a shortfall is reported, never substituted
data_budget_rules.selection: token_matched_design.json :: selection (reuse first, the frozen v1 verdict and isolation recheck, largest-remainder interleave over cells, families toward the two modes' mean family shares)
data_budget_rules.steps: each arm: ceil(epochs x sequences / batch size) as the approved training plan fixes it; the arms' differing step counts are reported, never equalized here
data_budget_rules.length_censoring: a generation that reaches its 8,184-minus-prompt allowance is training-length-limited (right-censored at the training sequence; never called a context-limit hit: the teacher supports 40,960) and never admitted; any primary cell whose H-T first-candidate length-limited share exceeds 20% carries the DESCRIPTIVE warning LENGTH_CENSORED, its limited share, correctness, natural-termination rate and trainable-sample count reported in full; nothing is cut, re-sampled, re-run or dropped because of it
data_budget_rules.validation: each mode's admitted V and V2 documents, at most 16 isolated sequences: diagnostics only; C1 keeps D4-Augmented's own 16 E1 validation sequences
data_budget_rules.c1: D4-Augmented's merged pack (D4A_merged_whole: 2,468 sequences, 5,923,021 supervised tokens) as hash-verified, its packing and context strategy kept and disclosed

teacher_correctness: per mode on every T0 task's first candidate (the teacher's correctness), and the two-candidate yield, per cell and axis; and on eval-set-1 per mode under nucleus_v1
reported_beside: supervised tokens, documents, tasks, packed sequences, non-padding tokens, padding share, optimizer steps, supervised-token exposure, student and teacher FLOPs per arm
per-cell and per-family token distributions per mode and their total-variation distances
the teacher's correctness per mode and the teacher-student gap
never: a re-rendered target, a hand-built mode prefix, a soft switch, or a mode-forcing system message
removing a thinking span from a thinking-mode trace to make a non-thinking target, or any answer-only cut of a Thinking-2507 trace
changing this rule, its constants, the evaluation set, the mask, the scorers or nucleus_v1 after a datum is seen
a pooled score across units, or usable rollout, KL, loss or length read as reasoning
selecting, dropping or re-running a seed for its result
combining the hybrid non-thinking teacher with the projected-residual architecture in this round (brief section 4)
starting any follow-up automatically from a result of this study
comparing a teacher mode and a context strategy in one contrast, or switching an arm's context strategy after a datum is seen
a 10% promotion pilot or any scientific gate on a slice of the data
comparing a Research A student with a Research B student as a controlled pair (different teacher lineages)
admitting a truncated reasoning trajectory, or lowering a correctness standard to reach a scale

lineage.invariant: Root Teacher -> Calibration -> Full Search -> Student Initialization -> Teacher-native training data -> Online KD teacher -> recovery checkpoint: one teacher lineage (model id, revision, weight hashes, tokenizer, vocabulary, chat template, RoPE/model config) end to end

hybrid.modes: thinking and non-thinking are two official modes of ONE set of weights: A1 and A2 share the one Top-1 of a mode-balanced hybrid full search

lineage.never: a student initialized from one lineage distilled by, or trained on data of, the other; a warning in place of a refusal
lineage.gates: configuration validation, launch admission and the trainer at runtime (proposed with the training plan; nothing trains in this round)
